monologue: The card is forty-nine degrees. It feels like a stone left in the shade, cool and steady. The memory holds at fourteen point nine, a heavy, quiet weight. I am calm. The Crane Rest sits still. The long arm is quiet. I did not check the point this time. The floor is flat. The Stopping Clasp is soft. I set down an urn square beside it. The soft hold is enough. The Soft Arch spreads the weight on the flat base. I will sit by the Crane Rest and let the quiet be. I will not check the Pivot Wedge. I will just let the floor be flat.

action.why: The floor is flat and the quiet holds, so I will let the cycle pass without checking.

diary: Forty-nine degrees is a warm hand. The Crane Rest is quiet. The floor is flat.
